svg.aria-label: WiPhone woods backplate start-here map: WiPhone expansion header, RFM95W radio, GPS module and the power section, with the antenna chain and do-not-connect rules.

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: What connects to what, in about thirty seconds. This is a MAP, not a manual. Every run is numbered W1–W20 to match the build sheet.
The plate fitted to phone 2 today is still v1: TLV62569 buck, no D1/D2.
Confirm every leg against docs/woods-backplate-wiring.svg before you solder.
1 · D2 BACKWARDS CHARGES THE PHONE'S OWN CELL
Both Schottkys' banded end (the cathode) must face the
buck-boost VIN. D2 reversed lets the pack's 4.9 V back-feed
VBAT and uncontrolled-charge the phone's LiPo. Meter the
band with a diode-test before you apply any power.
2 · 5V IS AN INPUT · 3.3V IS ONLY A SENSE WIRE
Push 5.2 V into the header's 5V terminal; never draw from it
(it reads 0 V on battery). Never power the plate from the 3.3V
terminal — a MIC5219, 150–200 mA total, and the radio alone
takes 120 mA transmitting. It carries EN sense only, in µA.
3 · WITHOUT R7 THE PHONE MAY NOT BOOT
10 kΩ from RFM95W pad 5 (NSS) to 3V3_PLATE. GPIO 27 floats
during every ESP32 reset; if NSS drifts low the radio drives
MISO — and MISO is GPIO 12 = MTDI, the flash-voltage boot
strap. High at reset release = 1.8 V VDD_SDIO = no boot.
ESP32 · all logic 3.3 V · no level shifters
stock plate ties it to GPIO 38 —
this one must not. See panel below.
W13 · GPIO_12 · SPI MISO — no series R (radio-driven)
W14 · GPIO_13 · SPI MOSI — R3 1 kΩ in series
W15 · GPIO_14 · SPI SCK — R4 1 kΩ in series
W16 · GPIO_27 · SPI NSS — R5 1 kΩ in series
SPI copies names side to side. Only the UART crosses.
W17 · GPIO_38 · GPS TX → phone RX — no series R (GPS-driven)
W18 · GPIO_32 · phone TX → GPS RX — R6 1 kΩ in series
— the header's 5 V is 0 V on battery
▲ will not run without a LiPo
✗ do NOT solder the USB-A jack
A BUCK will not do: a 1S
cell ends at 3.0 V and a
pads drawn by NET — go by the silk
W5 · PowerBoost GND → header GND · the ONE plate↔phone tie
W4 · PowerBoost 5.2 V → header 5V · this terminal is an INPUT
W20 · header VBAT → D2 → OR node · DRAW ONLY, never push
W12 · header 3.3V → buck-boost EN · SENSE ONLY, µA
▲ PS → GND: tie the buck-boost's PS pad LOW (BOM item 7b).
It carries no W-number on the build sheet — VERIFY it there first.
Not a wire. A 50 Ω path, and the part most often got wrong.
1 · Coax from pad 9 ANT (centre) + pad 10 GND (braid)
keep the run ≤ 5 mm, 50 Ω, grounded both sides
2 · u.FL / IPEX receptacle — option a, start here
lets you A/B the whip against the stock FPC antenna
its panel-mount SMA nut is what you drill the cover for
4 · 915 MHz whip — SMA MALE, not RP-SMA
they are not compatible and both are sold. Check twice.
▲ NEVER key up with no antenna fitted — it kills the PA.
Make the u.FL CLICK, not rest, and strain-relieve it at the battery edge.
R7 — THE PART BEGINNERS LEAVE OUT
GPIO 27 floats during every ESP32 reset. If NSS drifts
low the radio drives MISO — and MISO is GPIO 12 = MTDI,
the flash-voltage boot strap: 1.8 V VDD_SDIO, no boot.
Tied to the PLATE rail on purpose: dead pack, dead rail,
so R7 adds no phantom feed when the external pack dies.
BAT+ — cell to boost, through F1
GND — one node at the PowerBoost
EN sense — µA only, NOT power
GPS UART signal — thin, fine dash
RF coax — 50 Ω, not a wire
● = junction · crossing with no dot = NOT joined · ✗ = leave pad EMPTY
Power is thick and solid, signal is thin and dashed, so the two
read apart in greyscale as well as in colour.
✗ DO NOT CONNECT — the highest-value rules on this page
✗ RFM95W pad 14 (DIO0) → NOTHING. The stock v2.0 plate ties DIO0 to GPIO 38; this plate must not, because the GPS needs GPIO 38 — the only
input-only pin on the header. This is safe ONLY because mesh_phy.cpp polls and never calls attachInterrupt; if the Meshtastic PHY is ever made
interrupt-driven, this plate breaks. Before power, continuity from pad 14 to anything must read OPEN. A wire on pad 14 is WRONG.
✗ RFM95W pads 6 (RESET), 7, 11, 12, 15 and 16 → NC. Optional R2 10 kΩ from pad 6 to 3V3_PLATE; the stock plate leaves RESET floating too.
✗ Header I2C_SCL (GPIO 25), I2C_SDA (GPIO 15) and D0–D5 → unused. No level shifters anywhere — ESP32, RFM95W and GPS are all 3.3 V.
✗ PowerBoost EN, LBO, BAT and USB pads → not fitted; the cell connects via the JST only. Do NOT solder the loose USB-A jack.
▲ NEVER hard-parallel a second pack onto VBAT — unequal charge destroyed both packs' protection FETs in July 2026. VBAT is DRAW-only.
EVERY PART THAT SITS INSIDE A RUN
GPS power pad ↔ GPS GND · all ceramic
buck-boost EN ↔ GND · under 0.4 V phone-off
W14 MOSI · W15 SCK · W16 NSS · W18 GPS-RX
in the cell + leg · NOT 1 A
BUILD FROM THE SHEET, NOT FROM THIS MAP → docs/woods-backplate-wiring.svg · Order list: docs/woods-backplate-bom.md
